categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Bosses are fought at the end of specific chapters, and so are impossible to miss.

categories.title: Locked Door
categories.info: Locked Doors can only be opened once you've obtained a Key. Any Key will open any Locked Door.

categories.title: Secret Door
categories.info: Hidden doors that you need to reveal by doing a specific action, such as using the Darklight or removing an obstacle.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos are ghosts that hide in an object that is only invisible in a specific chapter. You need to collect all Boos in a mansion to unlock its Bonus stage.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gems are found by investigating objects or completing specific tasks. Collect all of a mansion's gems to unlock a crystal statue in the Vault.

categories.title: Key
categories.info: Keys can be used to unlock any Locked Door.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure are sources of money, including Coins, Bills and Ingots. We only mark sources worth 40 Coins or more.

locations.title: Ghost Onslaught
locations.description: You'll fight many ghost enemies and the Strong Sneaker when you return here with Toad.

locations.title: Overset Possessor
locations.description: Fought during C-3: Showtime.

locations.title: Warehouse Locked Door
locations.description: To open, turn the red wheel with the Poltergust so that the large clock on the door reads 3:30.

locations.title: Movements Locked Door
locations.description: Is opened in C-Boss: Showtime.

locations.title: Canyon Narrows Secret Door
locations.description: Vacuum up the fake wall sheet to open up this doorway.

locations.title: Crank Room Secret Door
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light on this spot to reveal this door.

locations.title: Combooter
locations.description: Take the red ribbon spool and place it in the [Ribbon Clamp](#loc=384496) on the left-hand side of the room. Vacuum it to reveal Combooter.

locations.title: Bootine
locations.description: After filling this room with sand, use the Dark-Light on the gap in the rock ramp at the back of the room to expose this Hidden Boo.

locations.title: Boodonkulous
locations.description: Discovered mandatorily as part of C-3: Roundhouse Brawl, after defeating the two Greenies.

locations.title: JamBoolaya
locations.description: In B-4: Play Catch, light up this lantern with the Dark-Light to expose the Boo.

locations.title: Boony RaBoot
locations.description: In C-5: Piece at Last, after riding up the gear to the upper level, head left and check behind the oil drum to pull down the fake wall. In the side-room, shine the Dark-Light in the front-left corner of the room to reveal a toolbox with Boony in it.

locations.title: Ruby #1
locations.description: Follow the train tracks right, flashing the red bomb to destroy the rubble as you go. At the end of the tracks, shine the Dark-Light on the buffer stop to reveal a toolbox with this Gem in it.

locations.title: Ruby #2
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light on a palette of cardboard boxes to reveal a hidden green ribbon spool. Put it in the [Ribbon Clamp](#loc=384496) and vacuum it to get this Ruby.

locations.title: Ruby #3
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light here to reveal a toolbox with this Ruby in it.

locations.title: Ruby #4
locations.description: During C-2: Underground Expedition, vacuum the sheet above the bed to reveal a paining of a Gem. Shine the Dark-Light on the painting to get the real Gem.

locations.title: Ruby #5
locations.description: During C-2: Underground Expedition, detour from Canyon Hall to the Canyon Stairs. Check the front-right corner for this Gem, up the wall and webbed up.

locations.title: Ruby #6
locations.description: While tugging the mine cart at the bottom of the room, check behind it for this cave with the Ruby stuck in some webs.

locations.title: Ruby #7
locations.description: In C-3: Roundhouse Brawl, held by a Greenie with a bucket on its head. To get it, vacuum the rug to reveal a red fan that controls the nearby clock: use it to change the time to 9:00, setting off an alarm that wakes the Greenie up. Defeat the Greenie to get the Ruubie!

locations.title: Ruby #8
locations.description: Cross south down the second set of metal beams, then to right and turn south around the corner. At the end will be a toolbox with this Ruby in it.

locations.title: Ruby #9
locations.description: From the bottom of the wooden stairs nearby, keep heading left to slip through a hole in the wall. Inside this small room will be the Ruby.

locations.title: Ruby #10
locations.description:
In the back area of this room during C-5: Piece at Last. To get here, use the Dark-Light to reveal some planks of wood that lets you cross over a bridge of wooden crates on the right side of the room. Here you'll find a shaking door: enter it to be taken to a Portal minigame.

To complete the minigame, grab all the Red Coins by going clockwise around the maze. Once you get them all, you can open the toolbox in the middle with the Gem inside.

locations.title: Ruby #11
locations.description: In C-5: Piece at Last at the bottom of this room, shine the Dark-Light at the southern side of the railing below the giant gear above to reveal this toolbox, with the Ruby inside.

locations.title: Ruby #12
locations.description: In C-5: Piece at Last, if you vacuum a sheet in the northeastern corner of this room, you'll expose a mirror with this Gem in the reflection. To reach it, come back here with Toad and fire them over the railing towards the camera.

locations.title: Ruby #13
locations.description: In C-Boss: Showtime, after getting through the [(c)locked door](#loc=384501), head to the left side of the Movements room until the camera turns to face the window. You'll be able to see this Ruby through it: use the Poltergust to grab it!

locations.title: Warehouse Key / 100 Coins
locations.description:
In C-1: A Timely Entrance, flash the safe with the Strobulb and grab the golden ribbon spool inside. Place it in the [Ribbon Clamp](#loc=384496) and vacuum it to get this Key.

In C-3: Roundhouse Brawl, this safe will have five Golden Spiders in it instead. You'll need to flash and lure a nearby bomb to burn down the webs blocking the safe first.

locations.title: Clock Tower Gate Key
locations.description: Awarded for defeating the ghosts in this room in C-1: A Timely Entrance.

locations.title: Transportation Hall Key
locations.description: Shine the Dark-Light onto the key picture to get a real Key.

locations.description: In C-1: A Timely Entrance, pick up two Gold Ingots next to the telescope.

locations.title: 41 G
locations.description: In C-1: A Timely Entrance, vacuum the pile of dirt in this corner to reveal two Gold Ingots, and a beetle.

locations.title: 80 G
locations.description: In C-1: A Timely Entrance, vacuum the two fans on the vent pipes at this point.

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description:
In B-1: A Timely Entrance, use the Dark-Light to reveal the missing chunk of train tracks to reach this toolbox.

In B-4: Play Catch, this will contain a Gold Bomb instead.

locations.title: 90 G

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In C-5: Piece at Last, shine the Dark-Light at this end of the balcony to reveal a toolbox, which has a Golden Bomb inside.

locations.title: 50 G

locations.title: 100 G

locations.description: In C-1: A Timely Entrance, open the toolbox here. There's also a Gold Ingot on top of the wooden crates nearby.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: In C-2: Underground Expedition, three Gold Beetles fly above this spot.

locations.title: 360 G
locations.description: In C-2: Underground Expedition, check to the right of the northern zipline to find this concealed door. Open each of the four chests to reveal a Golden Greenie.

locations.title: 172 G
locations.description: Up to 172 Coins can be earned while going down the Pit Slide.

locations.title: 60 G
locations.description: Check inside this corner for three Gold Ingots.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In this alcove is a Gold Ingot and three Gold Bats.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: After filling this room with sand, use the Dark-Light to expose [a bridge section](#loc=384524), letting you use the rock ramp to get to this toolbox with cash inside.

locations.title: 115 G
locations.description: Burn down the web wall to access this side-cave with a Chest and a Gold Ingot.

locations.title: 40 G
locations.description: Sitting as two Gold Ingots in this side-cave.

locations.title: 80 G
locations.description: In this side-cave, flash the four Gold Spiders with the Strobulb.

locations.title: 90 G
locations.description: In C-3: Roundhouse Brawl, chase the toolbox all the way to the end of the upper walkway, then open it to catch a Golden Greenie.

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: In C-3: Roundhouse Brawl, grab the green ribbon spool here in the cobwebs and take it down to the [Ribbon Clamp](#loc=384496) on the first floor. Yank it to get the cash!

locations.title: 100 G
locations.description: In C-3: Roundhouse Brawl, vacuum a spool of green ribbons here under the upper walkway from a cobweb. Put it in the [Ribbon Clamp](#loc=384496) to get 100 Coins!

locations.title: 60 G

locations.title: 60 G

locations.description: In this room, head under the wooden stairs to enter a secret room, where you can vacuum up the fake view in the window. This reveals a portal door you can use to enter a maze minigame. Collect all the Red Coins to unlock the toolbox in the middle!

locations.title: 70 G

locations.title: 40 G

locations.title: 40 G

locations.title: 95 G
locations.description: Open the toolbox at this spot for Coins!

locations.title: 40 G

locations.title: 40 G

locations.title: 101 G

locations.title: 37 G

locations.title: 275 G

locations.title: 40 G
locations.description: When you get to the top of this room, several spiders appear, including a Gold Spider. There's a second Gold Spider on the right-hand side of the room.

locations.title: Ribbon Clamp
